caption:
Bahamas: country 119 together is the land of Pirates of The Caribbean 🤭🌍💌
Unpopular opinion: we didn’t come to the Bahamas for the beaches. In fact, I’d actually say there are better beaches elsewhere in the Caribbean 😊💙

We came for pirate lore - for streets lined with stories of infamous captains, old taverns, legends passed down through generations, and restaurants that casually drop some of the wildest pirate trivia you’ll ever read. This colourful history here is impossible to ignore and honestly, that’s what made us have such fun in the Bahamas.

Did you know that, for a brief period in the early 1700s, Nassau was known as the “Pirate Republic”, a haven where legendary pirates like Blackbeard and Charles Vane came and went? And it is the inspiration for films like Pirates of The Caribbean 🏴‍☠️🤭

Would you rather spend a day beach hopping or hunting for pirate stories? ☠️🌊

#bruisedpassports #travel #bahamas

caption:
Lil me would never believe this 🥹🌍👇

I stepped onto my first flight at 18 & I could do so because of a scholarship. Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine that one day, I’d visit 116 countries.

And I definitely never imagined that I’d find someone who would dream just as wildly as I did 💌

What started as a love story became a story of shared dreams, endless curiosity, and choosing adventure over comfort:again and again.Every passport stamp and every sunrise has somehow brought us closer, not just to the world, but to each other. 116 countries later, I realize this journey was never just about travel.

Bruised Passports was about daring to dream bigger than our circumstances and travelling full time. It was about believing that an ordinary girl and boy could build an extraordinary life together 💌🌍

It was about saying “why not us?” when the world gave us every reason to play it safe. To everyone following our journey-thank you for being part of this dream.

I hope this reminds you to keep believing in impossible dreams, for taking leaps of faith, and for believing that when two people dream together, the world somehow feels a little smaller and the possibilities a LOT bigger.

Country 116 together - a reminder that dreams do come true, especially the ones you dare to chase together! 💌🌍

caption:
The world IS literally my office🌍💌 read👇
A personal story you might not know- just to put things in perspective ☺️
Every day we get a LOT of questions about how we finance our travels ourselves. Since we’ve answered this at length on our website multiple times (yep no rich parents or magic pills here!),I thought I’d share another story just to tell you NOTHING is impossible with the right amount of hard work & patience!
✨✨
Growing up my dad (a doctor) and my mom (teacher turned homemaker) spent all their earnings to provide the best possible education and standard of living to my brother and me. So when I left high school and entered university, I was determined to finance my own education so they could finally spend their salaries on themselves 😊
✨✨
I was passionate about English Literature and knew I wanted to pursue a PhD from one of the world’s best universities. I worked towards this in 3 ways ✨
✨
1) I tried to score the highest possible grades while pursuing my Bachelors and Masters degrees. Some years I succeeded in topping my university, some years I’d miss it by a mark or two.But I knew I’d worked as hard as I could!
2) After completing my Masters degree, I started teaching at the University of Delhi to gain work experience.
3) I spent ALL my savings and salary applying to as many universities as I could, spent months honing my SOPs and applications and emailing professors at various universities in US and UK. ✨
✨
Eventually I got my dream scholarship at University of Leeds, one of my top choices. The scholarship was generous and I supplemented it with odd academic jobs such as teaching English to Chinese students at my university and invigilating. But there was just one CATCH. ✨
✨
Writing a thesis takes anywhere b/w 5-6 years but my scholarship was only for 4 years. Cue LONG days and endless work for years but I ended up finishing my PhD thesis in 3.5 years
✨
Sharing this in the hope that it will inspire some of YOU to reach for your dreams. Academia, blogging, or life you just need to work tirelessly and prioritise your passion & give it everything😊NOTHING is impossible if you set your mind to it

#br

caption:
One of America’s cutest historic towns 🤏🚗🇺🇸

Everyone talks about Washington DC or Baltimore when planning a trip to Maryland. But some of the state’s most magical places and day trips lie beyond the obvious.

Frederick, Maryland is one of the prettiest historic towns in the USA we’ve visited - expect beautifully preserved architecture, brick-lined streets, local cafés, boutiques, public art, and centuries of history. If you’re looking for gems in the USA or unique day trips from Washington DC, Frederick honestly deserves a spot at the top of your list - especially if you’re going during autumn months 🍁🎃

We spent the day wandering through its charming downtown, discovering historic buildings around every corner - THIS is why you always take the scenic route 🇺🇸🚗

caption:
Gemini szn camera roll 🎞️🍰And ruminations…

I’m a big believer in intentionally designing my life year after year! The last chapter of my life was driven by ambition. This one is about ambition and rest 😊💫

In this chapter, I’m pivoting towards a life with softer mornings, deeper love, quieter joys, and enough space for my inner child to flourish. Over the years I’ve learnt that slowing down and savouring life isn’t laziness. It’s a strategy. A very good one ✨

These days, anything that spikes my cortisol (people, ideas, places, situations) is automatically out. We’re only entertaining peace, joy, and intention in this season of life 😇 And it’s affecting everything from my fitness & hair to my mental health - I know many of you have noticed that too 🤍

In this chapter of life I’m choosing 
Slow mornings. 
A steady nervous system
Relationships that feel safe
Privacy that’s been earned through years of hard work

This chapter feels less about proving and more about becoming.
Quiet.
Intentional.
Joyous.

The dreams are still big. The need to leave a legacy still matters. There are still mountains to climb and stories to tell ✨

But I’m no longer rushing through the journey to get somewhere else.

I’m here for the slow mornings.
The deeper love.
The bigger life.

Because I’ve always believed that the best things tend to flow when you’re aligned with your purpose, your values, your people, and yourself.

Here’s to another year of building a life that feels as beautiful on the inside as it looks on the outside. Because in a superficial world, choosing depth is a quiet rebellion and one of the most powerful decisions you can make 💌💫

Thank you for being part of this journey, for ALL the birthday love, and for growing alongside me over the years. 

Xx Savi 💋🫰

This journey is so good and this is such a beautiful layover you can see planes flying from so close ❤️❤️❤️❤️
I love the journey much more than the destination actually 😂 I'm weird that way. And give me coffee and chocolates... I'm sorted. I'm very easy to please 😛🤭
If Savi was my neighbor, I would get you to get these candies for me from all over the world 😝😝

In general, yes the entire journey matters. the flight though is, in relative terms, so short and we sleep through most of it. So our thought is we save up from the economy travel. But we should go with the bestbest experiences that we can each afford.
Damn those new business class seats on @flyswiss look good! I need to grab a good deal on them soon!
Fresh air on a layover? That’s a novelty.
